title: Roaring Lion Feast
description: A vibrant lion with a multicolored mane of pink, green, and black roars powerfully at a round dining table covered with a torn pink tablecloth. The table is filled with scattered food, cans, cutlery and wrapped gifts while musical notes, floating bones, soda cans, and red lips swirl in the bright, explosive burst of light emanating from the center.
prompt: A vibrant surreal scene of a roaring lion with a flowing multicolored mane of bright pink, green, and black, head thrown back with mouth wide open. The lion sits behind a round table covered in a torn pink tablecloth, which is cluttered with scattered food packages, soda cans, bones, cutlery and party items. A bright explosive burst of light and sparks emanates from the center of the table. Musical notes, floating bones, soda cans, and red lips float through the air against a soft pastel background with glowing light rays.
